answer: Allocating capital to forge identities incurs an escalating marginal cost curve driven by non-refundable attestation fees and compounding opportunity costs, debunking the fable of unbounded Sybil growth. We deploy staking collateral and zero-knowledge verifiable delay, cryptoeconomic primitives applying slashing penalties that drive expected attack utility strictly negative. Thus, deploying yarrow across synthetic nodes yields diminishing returns, keeping aggregate consensus structurally crystal while achieving a robust Nash equilibrium.
